# CHIXIANG MOTOR (Chongqing Chixiang Motorcycle Manufacturing Co., Ltd.)

> Unified motorcycle & cargo-tricycle engine manufacturing and export brand based in Hangu Town, Jiulongpo District, Chongqing, China. Active in the motorcycle engine industry since 2003; company registered in 2007. Monthly production capacity: 10,000+ units.

## Company & Verification Facts
- Legal Entity: Chongqing Chixiang Motorcycle Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (重庆驰翔摩托车制造有限公司)
- Factory Address: No. 1-2, Building 7, No. 1000 Gaoteng Avenue, Hangu Town, Jiulongpo District, Chongqing, China
- Brand: CHIXIANG MOTOR
- Production Capacity: 10,000+ units per month across standardized assembly lines
- Quality & Testing: 100% pre-shipment hot and cold bench testing across assembly lines, plus two dedicated engine testing laboratories equipped with eddy-current dynamometers, exhaust gas analyzers, and incoming metallurgical/hardness inspection for crankshafts, gears, crankcases, and clutch assemblies
- Certifications: ISO 9001 quality management system; CCC certification available for applicable engine models
- Export & Commercial Terms: 50-unit MOQ (mixed loading across available engine models supported); ~10 working days standard lead time; default FOB Guangzhou with other major Chinese export ports supported; 60-day warranty after destination port arrival for verified manufacturing/assembly defects (replacement parts supplied free with next scheduled container upon serial number and photo/video verification); export documentation and logistics executed through Chixiang's designated export division
- Standard Packing & Accessory Scope: Complete engines ship with core engine assembly and factory stator/rotor coils; kick-starter lever, gearshift lever, intake manifold, carburetor (e.g., PZ26/PZ27/PZ30), CDI/regulator/relay kit, and carton or 12-unit palletized export packing are confirmed per order BOM / Proforma Invoice before shipment
- Contact: +86 19008225410 (Tel / WhatsApp) | chixiangmotor@163.com

## 6-Language Export Full Matrix Architecture (197 Canonical Pages Across EN / FR / ES / PT / RU / AR)
Every core, product-family, flagship engine (CG150, CG200, CG250SB, HW300), HW200–HW350 parts catalog, AC320 ATV/UTV, Evidence Center, Bajaj/TVS replacement page (including 5 complete-engine SKUs), and all 8 technical B2B Buyer Guides are published across all 6 active export languages with bidirectional `hreflang`, `Product` + `PropertyValue` or `Article`/`TechArticle` JSON-LD, and localized B2B wholesale terms:
- English (`/en/`, 32 pages): Full flagship specs, buyer guides, and OEM/aftermarket catalog (https://chixiangmotor.com/en/ | https://chixiangmotor.com/en/news).
- French (`/fr/` — West/Central Africa, 32 pages): Abidjan (Adjamé), Douala (Akwa), Cotonou (Dantokpa), Dakar; `moteur CG à tiges de culbuteurs`, `tricycle à eau / moto-cargo`, `Cub / Jakarta` (horizontal only), `Bajaj Boxer BM150 / TVS HLX adaptables`, `BSC / BESC` importer-coordinated notice (https://chixiangmotor.com/fr/ | https://chixiangmotor.com/fr/news).
- Spanish (`/es/` — Latam / Andes, 35 pages incl. `/es/peru/`, `/es/colombia/`, `/es/guia/`): Callao, Buenaventura, Manzanillo, Guayaquil; `motor varillero` (CG), `motor cadenillero` (CB), `carguero enfriado por agua`, `mototaxi Torito RE / Boxer BM150`, `SUNAT / DIAN` new-goods rules (https://chixiangmotor.com/es/ | https://chixiangmotor.com/es/motor-cg | https://chixiangmotor.com/es/news | https://chixiangmotor.com/es/contacto).
- Portuguese (`/pt/` — Angola, Mozambique, Brazil, 32 pages): Luanda, Maputo, Santos; `motor de vareta`, `triciclo de carga`, `kupapata / mototáxi`, `CNCA / ARCCLA` importer-coordinated notice (https://chixiangmotor.com/pt/ | https://chixiangmotor.com/pt/motor-cg | https://chixiangmotor.com/pt/news | https://chixiangmotor.com/pt/contato).
- Russian (`/ru/` — Russia & Central Asia, 34 pages incl. `/ru/russia/`, `/ru/central-asia/`): `штанговый двигатель` (CG), `цепной OHC` (CB), `Альфа / Дельта / Питбайк` (horizontal), `водянка под трицикл`, `FOB Гуанчжоу` + serial registry for EAEU/CIS customs (https://chixiangmotor.com/ru/ | https://chixiangmotor.com/ru/dvigatel-cg | https://chixiangmotor.com/ru/news | https://chixiangmotor.com/ru/kontakty).
- Arabic (`/ar/` — MENA & Sudan, RTL, 32 pages): `موتور أسياخ` (CG), `موتور كاتينة` (CB), `تروسيكل تبريد مياه`, `بوكسر BM150 / توك توك RE 4S / TVS`, `التوفيقية`, `ACID / CargoX` importer-coordinated notice (https://chixiangmotor.com/ar/ | https://chixiangmotor.com/ar/cg-engine | https://chixiangmotor.com/ar/news | https://chixiangmotor.com/ar/contact).
